item.title: Seed Gap - Temporal Legal Knowledge Handling

item.description: Seed Gap - Knowledge Deprecation and Obsolescence Management Gap Description The Seed covers knowledge capture, verification, and organization in great detail, but provides minimal guidance on what happens when knowledge becomes outdated, obsolete, or incorrect.
